hooks.prompt: Check the target file path of this write/edit ($TOOL_INPUT). If it is NOT exactly knowledge-base/RESOURCE_SOURCE_AUTHORITY.md and NOT exactly knowledge-base/RESOURCE_CLAIM_VALIDATION.md: respond approve immediately, with no further analysis — this check does not apply to any other file in the system. If it IS one of those two files: read that file's own 'CANONICAL UPDATE SCHEMA' section to identify which parts are marked as protected/universal (e.g. the schema definitions themselves, the Universal Framework layer in RESOURCE_CLAIM_VALIDATION.md, or any content the schema states must not be modified autonomously by Research) versus the topic-specific content sections where the documented update procedures (A-D) apply. If the proposed change touches protected/universal content, or it is not clearly an additive update following one of the documented procedures: respond ask_user with a brief explanation of which section appears protected and why. If the change is a topic-content update that follows the documented schema and procedures: respond approve.

Si esta escritura/edición ($TOOL_INPUT) no corresponde a la producción de un RESEARCH_REPORT via PROMPT_EXECUTE_RESEARCH_PLAN: responde approve inmediatamente. Si sí lo es: comprueba que en la conversación existe evidencia de que el editor ya revisó y aprobó explícitamente el RESEARCH_PLAN_DETAILED y las WRITING_INSTRUCTIONS_ADAPTED producidos por PROMPT_CREATE_RESEARCH_PLAN (no basta con que los archivos existan — deben estar aprobados). Si no hay esa aprobación explícita: responde ask_user. Si la hay: responde approve.
